title: Great tour, great way to see the city, and awesome guide.
text:
On a recent family trip to Barcelona, Spain, I was fortunate enough to get away for an evening and spend six hours exploring the city with Aperture Tours. This was my third experience with Aperture, following previous photography tours in London and Paris, and once again I came away having had a wonderful experience—and with far more photographs that I was happy with than I expected.

For this tour, my guide was Emily, and she was absolutely fantastic.

author: jamesfike

title: Honestly one of the best experiences we have done.
text: Our professional photographer, Emily Kerr, was excellent. She was immediately able to set the right pace based on our experience. Emily used kind questions to ascertain what knowledge we had and then worked with us to enable the brilliant results….. Images of Barcelona we would never have known where to look for or to see. Overall, I would highly rate this experience to anyone keen on photography and eager to improve…. Emily has made this short break away a real memory. Thank you.

title: Beautiful Barcelona tour
text: My photo tour with Emily was educational and fun. I'm a photographer and wanted an opportunity to shoot street scenes in Barcelona. She knew all the best areas to photograph in Barcelona from different angles and perspectives. Great tour!

title: We went to a few places around Barcelona and took night and street photos.

title: Excellent tour and guide for photographing Barcelona!
text: If you’re a photographer of any skill level this is a great way to see various sights of the city and also capture some great perspectives too! Ian was fantastic and aligned the tour with the style of photography I wanted and also shared great insights to the city. This was a highlight of my four day trip to Barcelona! author: jamesmI6227VJ

title: Two wonderful evenings in Barcelona
text: I booked both tours - the Street Photo Tour and the Night Photo Tour. Both were great. Emily is a wonderful photographer who knows many secret places in Barcelona. She taught me a lot about street photography and I took photos that I would never have taken otherwise. But I also spent some wonderful hours talking about anything and everything. I can only recommend this tour.

title: Outstanding photo tour with Ian
text: Outstanding photo tour with Ian. He's super friendly, and very knowledgeable about photography and the city. A great way to spend an evening in Barcelona if you're a photography fan.

title: Great tour
text: The tour was great. Ian tailored the tour so I could visit various places and take some great photos, giving me tips along the way as well as some history. Would definitely book again!!

title: Barcelona Night Shoot
text: The Barcelona night tour was perfect. Ian focused on making sure I used good technique to get night shots. He knows Barcelona in and out and made sure that we had the best vantage points for shooting. Muchas gracias!
